**4B.6 Research Note**

Bottom line: No. I found no credible 2024 evidence that Khamenei protected independent media or information access. The strongest material points the other way: journalists and other critics were intimidated, independent oversight was absent, and the state relied on coercive surveillance and punishment rather than press freedom.

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Iran: Chokehold on Dissent | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/iran-chokehold-dissent | HRW described retaliation against critics and explicitly included journalists among those targeted by arrests, intimidation, and coercive state action. That is direct evidence against protection of independent media. | 4B.6, 4B.3, 4B.5 |
| Iran: authorities unleash heavily militarized clampdown to hide protest massacres | Amnesty International | 2024-03-06 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/ | Amnesty documented a broad coercive campaign involving surveillance, police checks, prosecutions, flogging, and prison terms across multiple state bodies. While not a media-specific report, it supports a hostile information environment rather than one protecting independent reporting. | 4B.6, 4B.3, 4B.5 |
| Iran: two years after Woman Life Freedom uprising, impunity for crimes reigns supreme | Amnesty International | 2024-09-11 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/ | Amnesty said authorities still had not carried out impartial investigations and instead used harassment and arbitrary detention against victims’ families. This reinforces a pattern of intimidation and information control, not press protection. | 4B.6, 4B.3, 4B.5 |

**Search gap**
- I did not find a reliable 2024 source showing Khamenei took any affirmative step to protect independent media, reduce censorship, or improve information access.
- I also did not surface a strong 2024 source specifically on media ownership pressure, newsroom closures, internet throttling, or a named propaganda campaign tied to Khamenei; the best evidence available is indirect but consistently negative.
